description: This Java class 'StartupFrame' provides a GUI startup window for the rusEfi console application. It allows the user to select a serial port or TCP connection, configure baud rate, and initialize the connection to the device or start a simulator. The class manages port discovery, UI interactions, and launching appropriate subsystems for firmware flashing, erasing, and establishing communication channels.

classes.name: StartupFrame
classes.description: A class that creates a startup window for selecting communication ports, configuring connection parameters, and launching the device or simulator.

methods.name: StartupFrame
methods.description: Constructor initializing the startup GUI, setting up port scanning, and handling window close behavior.

methods.name: setAppIcon
methods.description: Sets the application icon for a given JFrame.

methods.name: chooseSerialPort
methods.description: Configures the GUI components for serial port selection, connection, and additional options like firmware flashing and simulator launch.

methods.name: installMessage
methods.description: Sets tooltip text for a UI component.

methods.name: findAndApplyPorts
methods.description: Discovers available serial/TCP ports and updates the UI accordingly.

methods.name: findAllAvailablePorts
methods.description: Returns a list of all available serial and TCP ports.

methods.name: disposeFrameAndProceed
methods.description: Stops port scanning and closes the startup frame, proceeding to next steps.

methods.name: addPortSelection
methods.description: Populates the port selection combo box with available ports.

methods.name: createSpeedCombo
methods.description: Creates and configures a combo box for selecting baud rates.
